name: quietest
about: The quietest whole block sets the level, not the last or the mean

name: straddle
about: Blocks are counted from the first frame played, so a quiet run that straddles two blocks is diluted

name: stereo
about: A block's mean square spans every channel

name: cap
about: Audio that never falls quiet fills a silence at -60 dBFS, not at its own level

name: silent
about: A source that was already silent gets no noise

name: remeasure
about: Too little audio to fill a block keeps the previous level, and each silence measures afresh from the audio after the last one
